mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO fund_nav ( id, fund_code, nav_date, unit_nav, accumulated_nav, daily_growth_rate, source, source_time, fetch_batch_id, data_version, checksum, quality_status, quality_reason, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.fundCode}, #{item.navDate}, #{item.unitNav}, #{item.accumulatedNav}, #{item.dailyGrowthRate}, #{item.source}, #{item.sourceTime}, #{item.fetchBatchId}, #{item.dataVersion}, #{item.checksum}, #{item.qualityStatus}, #{item.qualityReason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
ON CONFLICT (fund_code, nav_date) DO UPDATE SET unit_nav = EXCLUDED.unit_nav, accumulated_nav = EXCLUDED.accumulated_nav, daily_growth_rate = EXCLUDED.daily_growth_rate, source = CASE WHEN fund_nav.source = 'AKSHARE_ALL' OR EXCLUDED.source = 'AKSHARE_ALL' THEN 'AKSHARE_ALL' WHEN fund_nav.source LIKE 'AKSHARE_DAYS_%' AND EXCLUDED.source LIKE 'AKSHARE_DAYS_%' THEN 'AKSHARE_DAYS_' || GREATEST( CAST(SUBSTRING(fund_nav.source FROM 14) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTRING(EXCLUDED.source FROM 14) AS INTEGER) ) ELSE EXCLUDED.source END, source_time = EXCLUDED.source_time, fetch_batch_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fetch_batch_id, fund_nav.fetch_batch_id), data_version = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.data_version, fund_nav.data_version), checksum = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.checksum, fund_nav.checksum), quality_status = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.quality_status, fund_nav.quality_status), quality_reason = EXCLUDED.quality_reason, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE fund_nav.unit_nav IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.unit_nav OR fund_nav.accumulated_nav IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.accumulated_nav OR fund_nav.daily_growth_rate IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.daily_growth_rate OR fund_nav.checksum IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.checksum OR fund_nav.quality_status IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.quality_status OR fund_nav.quality_reason IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.quality_reason
mapper.select: SELECT nav_date AS date, unit_nav, accumulated_nav, daily_growth_rate, source, source_time, data_version, quality_status FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} ORDER BY nav_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(MAX( CASE WHEN source = 'AKSHARE_ALL' THEN 5000 WHEN source LIKE 'AKSHARE_DAYS_%' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(source FROM 14) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode}

SELECT 'FUND_NAV' AS dataset, fund_code, nav_date AS business_date, fetch_batch_id, data_version, checksum, quality_status, quality_reason, source, source_time FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} ORDER BY nav_date DESC LIMIT 1
